brief:
High-level officials in Arab countries are conducting intensive talks with advisers close to Gadi Eisenkot to prepare for the period following Israeli elections scheduled for October, according to Hebrew Channel 15. The contacts represent efforts by regional governments to anticipate shifts in Israeli politics.

The regional preparations aim to account for potential changes to the political map and the formation of a new government in Israel. Officials are positioning themselves to engage with Eisenkot's circle ahead of any transition in power.
